items.title: ResolutionRecord V1 contract and pure normalization
scope: canonical JSON Schema and TypeScript type
pure condition and logical path normalization
acceptance: schema rejects unknown and machine-specific fields
conditions follow the mode protocol order
logical paths contain no absolute, parent, backslash, drive or pnpm store paths
input ordering does not change canonical output
existing ProductGraph V1 output is unchanged
nonGoals: Vite, TypeScript, Node or Vitest adapters
evidence: 2026-09-06 on macOS 27.0 (26A5425a), Node v24.20.0 and pnpm 10.32.1: build, typecheck, 74 Vitest tests, 8 S1 tests and verify:docs passed; result recorded in .codex/tasks/a1-s2-01-resolution-record-2026-09-06.md

items.title: Package exports and relative source resolver
scope: package exports and relative ESM resolution
declared dependency and package escape checks
acceptance: private, undeclared and escaping imports fail before code execution
records are independent of checkout and pnpm store paths
evidence: 2026-09-06 on macOS 27.0 (26A5425a), Node v24.20.0 and pnpm 10.32.1: build, typecheck, 92 Vitest tests, 8 S1 tests and verify:docs passed; result recorded in .codex/tasks/a1-s2-02-source-resolver-2026-09-06.md

items.title: Target boundary and dynamic import policy
scope: static and opaque dynamic import classification
acceptance: server secrets and built-ins cannot enter web/shared
evidence: 2026-09-06 on macOS 27.0 (26A5425a), Node v24.20.0 and pnpm 10.32.1: build, typecheck, 109 Vitest tests, 8 S1 tests and verify:docs passed; result recorded in .codex/tasks/a1-s2-03-target-import-policy-2026-09-06.md

items.title: Tool adapters and cross-platform S2 evidence
scope: TypeScript, Node, Vite and Vitest trace adapters
acceptance: Linux, macOS and Windows transcripts match
S2 pass criteria are completely evidenced
evidence: 2026-09-06 on macOS 27.0 (26A5425a), arm64, Node v24.20.0 and pnpm 10.32.1: TypeScript 5.9.3, Vite 8.2.2, Node and Vitest 4.1.11 reconciled five modes across two checkouts and two isolated pnpm stores; 109 Vitest, 8 S1 and 4 S2 tests plus build, typecheck and verify:docs passed. Canonical transcript is spikes/s2-resolver/transcripts/macos-arm64.json. Linux/Windows remain unrun, so the item stays in progress.
